description: This file defines the LeaveRequestDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the HRM Leave Plugin. The class provides methods to manipulate and retrieve information related to leave requests, such as setting employee and leave type references and fetching formatted dates and comments.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing enhanced access and manipulation methods for LeaveRequest entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific LeaveRequest entity.

methods.name: getLeaveRequest
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying LeaveRequest object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the LeaveRequest based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Associates a LeaveType entity with the LeaveRequest based on leave type ID.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Retrieves the date the leave was applied for, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave request.
